title: EU fines Alibaba's AliExpress €550 million over illegal product sales
summary: The European Union has fined Alibaba's AliExpress a record €550 million for failing to stop the sale of illegal goods, including counterfeit products and unsafe toys. The fine follows an investigation launched in March 2024 under the Digital Services Act. This penalty highlights the EU's efforts to regulate online marketplaces and protect consumers from harm.
summary_points: The European Union has fined Alibaba's AliExpress a record €550 million
The fine is related to the company's failure to stop the sale of illegal goods
The investigation was launched under the Digital Services Act in March 2024
This penalty aims to regulate online marketplaces and protect consumers
AliExpress will fight back against the fine
